description: Marks the Trello board specified by idBoard as viewed for the current user, exclusively updating its viewed status and potentially influencing its position in user-specific lists and notification settings.

idBoard.description: The unique identifier of the Trello board to be marked as viewed.
idBoard.title: Id Board

name: mark_board_as_viewed

MarkBoardAsViewedResponse.description:
Response schema for `MarkBoardAsViewed`

Empty response body returned on successful operation. This endpoint marks a board as
viewed and returns HTTP 200 OK with no content in the response body.
MarkBoardAsViewedResponse.title: MarkBoardAsViewedResponse
